---
title: Immunisation register to notifiable disease records
---

## Question

Can immunisation histories be linked to later disease notifications when identifiers are incomplete or out of date?

## Data

Synthetic register and notification extracts with missing address fields, changed surnames, and occasional date transpositions.

## Linkage strategy

Use probabilistic linkage with partial identifiers and compare the effect of stricter versus looser review thresholds.

## Result

The example highlights the trade-off between missed true links and over-linking in sparse identifier settings.

## Reporting

Report which identifiers were absent, how they were handled, and how linkage uncertainty could affect vaccine effectiveness or surveillance estimates.
